sv.title: Jensen Huang ska höras i USA:s kongress
sv.summary: Amerikanska chipjätten Nvidias tidigare vd Jensen Huang ska framträda inför USA:s kongress den 1 december.

en.title: Jensen Huang to testify before US Congress
en.summary: Former CEO of US chip giant Nvidia Jensen Huang is to appear before the US Congress on 1 December.
